operations.detail: PR-based handoff branch again contained the same three non-slot/shared files; branch head rejected as publisher input.
PR 411 closed unmerged; no shared-path conflict resolution attempted by child slot.
Repeated PR replacement loop stopped under bounded-recovery policy; recovery manifest recorded.
Verified slot output moved to Git object/tree construction so later branch automation cannot alter the handoff commit.
Fresh canonical tree overlaid only with verified gas_emissions_2 slot paths; excluded three contaminated shared paths.
Immutable squash commit verified as slot-only payload; shared contaminated paths are not part of the commit.
Branch head later changed again, but immutable commit remained unchanged; branch head marked non-authoritative.
Serial publisher instructed to use immutable commit SHA(s), never mutable branch heads.
